eu_ai_act_art50.note: Aug 2 2026 full enforcement for general-purpose and high-risk AI obligations. Art.50 transparency tier penalties: up to 15M EUR or 3% worldwide annual turnover (the 35M EUR / 7% maximum applies ONLY to Art.5 prohibited-practices). Art.50 transparency + synthetic-content watermarking NOT deferred by the Digital Omnibus.

oregon_sb1546.version: OR SB 1546 AI Companion Platform Safety

coppa_2025.requirements: Age verification before collecting personal info from under-13. Verifiable parental consent (VPC) — including a separate, verifiable parental consent specifically for using a child's personal information to train AI/ML systems (2026-04-22 amended rule). Expanded PII now includes biometric identifiers and government-issued IDs. Indefinite-retention ban: a written data-retention policy is mandatory and children's data may only be retained as long as reasonably necessary. Separate consent required for third-party sharing. Data minimization for children. Parental access/deletion rights.
